title: Reactive ContainerResponseFilter throws NPE
body:
## Describe the bug
When a ContainerResponseFilter is active in a reactive rest application,
and we try to use `getResourceMethod()` on the `ResourceInfo` object,
NullPointerException is observed. Also, the filter doesn't seem to be invoked at all on some endpoints.


### Expected behavior
Should not throw NPE

### Actual behavior
NPE is thrown.

## To Reproduce

I've attached a reproducer. It's just the `getting-started-reactive` project with the following file added to it:

```
package org.acme.getting.started;

import javax.annotation.Priority;
import javax.ws.rs.Priorities;
import javax.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestContext;
import javax.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseContext;
import javax.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseFilter;
import javax.ws.rs.container.ResourceInfo;
import javax.ws.rs.core.Context;
import javax.ws.rs.ext.Provider;

@Priority(Priorities.HEADER_DECORATOR)
@Provider
public class Filter implements ContainerResponseFilter {

	@Context
	ResourceInfo resourceInfo;

	@Override
	public void filter(final ContainerRequestContext requestContext, final ContainerResponseContext responseContext) {

		System.out.println(resourceInfo.getResourceMethod());
	}
}
```

1. Start the app, `./mvnw quarkus:dev`
2. GET localhost:8080/hello/greeting/Johan
    Confirm that no NPE is thrown and that the correct method signature is printed on stdout
3. GET localhost:8080/hello/greet
    NPE is thrown. Correct behavior would be to see the string null on stdout
4. GET localhost:8080/hello/greeting/3/Johan
    Note that the filter is not invoked at all this time. Nothing is printed on stdout
